events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit, stack ports and reports
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -1 a1c8b18a 2>&1; git branch --contains a1c8b18a 2>&1|head; git status -sb | head -2; ls /tmp/t242c | head -30; for p in 8970 8972 8974; do echo "$p: $(lsof -ti:$p | head -2 | tr '\n' ' ')"; done; ls /tmp/walk/ | grep 242

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find stack bring-up scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-242* 2>&1; ls app/scripts | grep -i -E 'stack|chain|walk' ; grep -rl "t242c" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/ 2>/dev/null | head; /usr/sbin/lsof -v >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo lsof-ok
